$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (hi column), checked value by value against WordByWordPrototype/Localizable.xcstrings (localizations.hi), plus the app's Free/Plus comparison screen (FeatureQuotaManager.swift featureDisplayName: 'अनुवाद के लिए स्वाइप करें (क्लाउड अनुवाद इंजन / स्थानीय इंजन)', 'AI अर्थ के लिए डबल टैप करें', 'AI उच्चारण (शब्द / वाक्य)', 'अधिक परिभाषाएँ', 'खंड निष्कर्षण', 'वाक्य क्रिया प्रवाह', 'एआई वाक्य रचना संरचना विश्लेषण', 'स्थानीय संश्लेषित आवाज़'; limit_per_day%lld = 'दिन में %lld बार'); §7.2.2 rules ①–③ and fix X10; §7.3 hi row (आप; 'दाईं ओर स्वाइप करें', 'डबल टैप करें'); §7.7 hi row (nukta spelt the same way throughout; AI, iPhone, App Store in Latin letters).

required: kickers, quota-table rows, demo.ui.more and the chunks flow label use the app's names verbatim (rule ①). hi has no short name for the swipe feature (T-A '—'), so the swipe kicker and rows use the feature name 'अनुवाद के लिए स्वाइप करें'; the lookup name 'AI अर्थ के लिए डबल टैप करें' has no '(AI Meaning)' suffix to drop. Rows are shortened to 'feature · engine' as in the other locales. Action Flow keeps the App Store name (doc 08 D3, §7.2.3); features[chunks].text quotes the app's 'वाक्य क्रिया प्रवाह' once. The syntax row keeps the app's own spelling 'एआई' (grammar_structure_analysis); body copy writes 'AI' (§7.7).

Rule ③ / X10: the app's audio_playback_title_streaming = 'AI पढ़ाई' and audio_playback_title_local = 'स्थानीय पढ़ाई' use पढ़ाई ('studies'); the site writes 'AI से पढ़कर सुनाना' / 'स्थानीय आवाज़ से पढ़कर सुनाना' and never quotes the app names (reported to the app side in docs/redesign-2026/ops/m3/hi-qa.md).
contains: app buttons, screens and settings that sentences quote between “ ” so readers find them on screen (T-B, T-D, T-E).

banned: a left swipe (it removes the translation, F14); a single tap for the word lookup (doc 08 §1.1); mouse wording; पढ़ाई (X10); one spelling per word: हिन्दी (as in the language switcher), वेब पेज, डबल टैप; nukta letters as base + U+093C (NFC) and never dropped (§7.7), so the lint patterns see one form; 'एआई' outside the two quoted app names; gendered first-person questions (हूँ) — the copy addresses the reader with आप or uses the passive. The claims-lint rules cover selection-to-translate ('चुनते ही', 'टेक्स्ट चुन') and the jargon 'संरेखण' (C-16).
